calibration_shape.remedy: shrink toward the base rate on the log-odds scale (slope < 1); an additive shift would over-correct the low end and under-correct the high end

prior.caveat: fitted on the pick-gate replay's Elo-from-strength route, not the live DC-priced route, so it is a PRIOR: the live buckets override it as soon as they hold more settled evidence of their own. Not applied to published probabilities or to selection until that trade-off is signed off.

route_comparison.verdict: DC prices more sharply than Elo (slope 1.20 vs 0.72) — the overconfidence is largely a property of the Elo fallback, and a prior fitted on it would over-haircut DC-priced picks

route_head_to_head.note: same fixtures, same gate, same shaves - only the pricing route differs

disagreement_split.verdict: DC is closer to reality in 0 of 4 disagreement bands, Elo in 4

dc_floor_ab.verdict: the relaxation admitted 732 extra fixtures that were worse on hit rate, loss rate and non-loss rate alike — it was buying volume, not accuracy

draw_risk.verdict: refusing the 50% highest-draw-risk picks (141 fixtures) beats doing nothing: non-loss 95.0% → 95.7%, losses 5.0% → 4.3%, for 281 → 140 picks

opponent_quality.reason: loss reduction is real and consistent across 62/62 leave-one-league-out folds but Fisher p = 0.16 at the volume-friendly threshold (#12); held as evidence until it clears p < 0.05

exclusions: EV/odds gate not replayed here: prices are now STORED (match_odds, 2026-10-04) but ESPN only retains them for the current season (measured: 2026 90% priced, 2025 8%, 2024 0%), so a full-history EV replay is still not possible. The EV gate can only shrink the live set

DC route is replayed no-look-ahead from a streaming fit (same half-life/prior/caps as live, keyed by entity_id); it is not byte-identical to a rebuild of today's ratings, and it prices only fixtures where both sides were rated at kickoff
